component.name: Pixel Connect
component.summary: Quick Share, clipboard and device integration for Google Pixel phones

description.p: Pixel Connect unifies Google Pixel connectivity on Linux. It provides Google Quick Share, KDE Connect device integration (pairing, clipboard synchronisation and file sharing) implemented in process, a "Send to Pixel" entry for the Files context menu, ADB device detection and scrcpy screen mirroring, and an optional SSH client integration.
Everything works locally; no cloud service or account is required.
